perk-survivalist.name: Survivalist
perk-survivalist.description: Finds food and shelter easily (+15 Survival).

perk-lucky.name: Lucky
perk-lucky.description: Rerolls one failed check per match.

perk-brute.name: Brute
perk-brute.description: Hits harder and takes more blows (+10 Melee, +4 HP).

perk-silver-tongue.name: Silver tongue
perk-silver-tongue.description: Talks their way out of anything (+10 Persuasion, +10 Deception).

perk-tough.name: Tough
perk-tough.description: Hard to bring down (+10 Endurance, +8 HP).

perk-quick.name: Quick
perk-quick.description: Fast on their feet, escapes easily (+10 Athletics).

perk-arcane-spark.name: Arcane spark
perk-arcane-spark.description: A touch of magic, even without training (+15 Magic).

perk-charming.name: Charming
perk-charming.description: Makes friends quickly (+5 Persuasion, alliances more likely).

item-spear.description: Keeps foes at a distance and catches fish (damage 6).

item-crossbow.description: Slow to load, hard to stop (ranged, damage 7).

item-throwing-knives.description: A handful of quick blades (ranged, damage 4).

item-rope.description: Gets you out of pits and up walls (+5 Athletics).

event-find-chapel.success: Searching a ruined chapel, {a} finds {item} under a toppled statue of a forgotten saint.
event-find-chapel.failure: {a} searches a ruined chapel for an hour and finds only pigeons, who are not pleased.

event-find-chest.success: {a} spots a chest half buried in the moss and pries out {item}.
event-find-chest.failure: {a} digs up a promising chest. It is full of very old socks.

event-find-camp.success: {a} comes across an abandoned camp, still warm, and leaves with {item}.
event-find-camp.failure: {a} finds an abandoned camp, but someone was faster: only ashes remain.

event-find-tree.success: {a} climbs an ancient oak to reach a bundle caught in its branches: {item}.
event-find-tree.failure: {a} tries to climb an ancient oak, slips twice and decides that whatever is up there can stay there.

event-find-river.success: {a} fishes a waterlogged satchel out of the river. Inside: {item}.
event-find-river.failure: {a} wades into the river after a floating satchel and comes back with nothing but wet boots.

event-find-armoury.success: Under cover of darkness, {a} slips into the arena's old armoury and takes {item}.
event-find-armoury.failure: {a} tries to sneak into the old armoury, knocks over a rack of shields and flees in a terrible clatter.

event-find-lantern-night.success: Despite the darkness, {a} notices a glint between two rocks: {item}.
event-find-lantern-night.failure: {a} gropes around in the dark for a glint seen at dusk and finds only a very surprised toad.

event-gift-sky.only: A small parachute drifts down from the sky and lands at the feet of {a}: {item}, with a note saying "Good luck!"

event-forage-berries.success: {a} finds a thicket of blackberries and eats until {{a:his|her|their}} fingers are purple.
event-forage-berries.failure: {a} eats a handful of bright red berries. The rest of the afternoon is spent regretting it.

event-forage-hunt.success: {a} brings down a hare with a single shot and roasts it over a small fire.
event-forage-hunt.failure: {a} spends the morning chasing a hare. The hare wins.

event-forage-fish.success: {a} catches three fat trout with bare hands and a lot of patience.
event-forage-fish.failure: {a} tries to catch fish with bare hands and falls in the stream. The fish seem amused.

event-forage-mushrooms.success: {a} recognises a ring of edible mushrooms and makes a surprisingly good soup.
event-forage-mushrooms.failure: {a} eats a pretty blue mushroom and spends an hour discussing philosophy with a tree.

event-forage-spring.success: {a} follows the sound of water to a clear spring and drinks deeply.
event-forage-spring.failure: {a} drinks from a muddy puddle out of thirst. It was not a good idea.

event-hazard-pit.success: {a} notices loose branches on the path just in time and steps around a deep pit trap.
event-hazard-pit.failure: {a} falls into a pit trap and needs a long, painful time to climb back out.
event-hazard-pit.defeated: {a} falls into a deep pit trap and cannot climb out; at nightfall, the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-hazard-quicksand.success: {a} sinks into quicksand up to the knees, but pulls free with a mighty effort.
event-hazard-quicksand.failure: {a} gets out of the quicksand, exhausted and covered in mud.
event-hazard-quicksand.lost: {a} escapes the quicksand, but {theItem} is swallowed by the mud.
event-hazard-quicksand.defeated: {a} is caught in quicksand up to the chest; the arena wardens carry {a} away, unconscious.

event-hazard-rockslide.success: A rockslide thunders down the slope; {a} dives aside just in time.
event-hazard-rockslide.failure: A rockslide catches {a}, who limps away bruised and dusty.
event-hazard-rockslide.defeated: A rockslide buries {a} up to the shoulders; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-hazard-bees.success: {a} disturbs a wild beehive and outruns the whole swarm, waving both arms.
event-hazard-bees.failure: {a} disturbs a wild beehive. The bees have opinions, and share them at length.
event-hazard-bees.defeated: {a} is chased by a furious swarm of bees into the river; the arena wardens carry {a} away, very swollen.

event-hazard-cold.success: The night is freezing, but {a} curls up under a rock and holds on until dawn.
event-hazard-cold.failure: The night is freezing and {a} shivers until dawn without a wink of sleep.
event-hazard-cold.defeated: The cold is too much for {a}; at dawn, the arena wardens carry {a} away, wrapped in a blanket.

event-hazard-runes.success: {a} recognises warding runes carved on an archway and walks around it. Wise choice.
event-hazard-runes.failure: {a} walks under an archway carved with runes, which go off in a flash of blue fire.
event-hazard-runes.defeated: {a} triggers a rune trap and is thrown across the clearing; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-hazard-snake.success: {a} spots a viper coiled in the grass and gives it a very respectful berth.
event-hazard-snake.failure: A viper bites {a}, who spends a feverish hour sucking out the venom.
event-hazard-snake.defeated: A viper bites {a}; the fever comes fast, and the arena wardens carry {a} away to the healers.

event-hazard-river.success: {a} crosses a fast river from stone to stone without even wetting a boot.
event-hazard-river.failure: {a} slips crossing the river and is carried downstream before reaching the bank.
event-hazard-river.lost: {a} slips crossing the river; the current carries away {theItem}.
event-hazard-river.defeated: {a} is swept away by the river; the arena wardens carry {a} away far downstream.

event-rest-cave.only: {a} finds a dry cave and sleeps soundly for the first time since the start.

event-rest-tree.only: {a} ties {{a:himself|herself|themself}} to a high branch and sleeps above the arena, out of reach.

event-quiet-song.only: {a} sings an old song to keep up {{a:his|her|their}} courage. Somewhere in the dark, someone hums along.

event-quiet-sharpen.only: {a} spends a quiet hour sharpening, polishing and admiring {{a:his|her|their}} gear.

event-quiet-stars.only: {a} lies on {{a:his|her|their}} back and counts the stars, wondering how it all came to this.

event-quiet-squirrel.only: {a} has a long conversation with a squirrel. The squirrel makes some excellent points.

event-quiet-practice.only: {a} practises alone in a clearing, striking at shadows until the moves feel right.

event-quiet-watch.only: {a} keeps watch all night with {{a:his|her|their}} back to a rock. Nothing comes. That is almost worse.

event-potion.only: {a} uses {theItem}; the wounds close and the colour comes back.

event-treat.success: {a} cleans and binds {{a:his|her|their}} wounds with steady hands.
event-treat.failure: {a} tries to bandage a wound and makes it worse. Bandaging is harder than it looks.

event-arena-mist.success: A grey mist rolls over the arena, heavy and choking; {a} holds {{a:his|her|their}} breath and pushes through.
event-arena-mist.failure: A choking mist rolls over the arena and {a} comes out coughing, eyes streaming.
event-arena-mist.defeated: The choking mist swallows {a}; when it lifts, the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-arena-fire.success: A wall of magical fire sweeps across the arena; {a} sprints ahead of it and makes it out.
event-arena-fire.failure: A wall of magical fire sweeps across the arena and singes {a}, who smells of roast for the rest of the day.
event-arena-fire.defeated: The wall of fire cuts off every path for {a}; the arena wardens carry {a} away through a hidden door.

event-arena-storm.success: A storm summoned by the arena masters breaks overhead; {a} weathers it under a ledge.
event-arena-storm.failure: The arena masters summon a storm, and a bolt of lightning lands far too close to {a}.
event-arena-storm.defeated: Lightning strikes right next to {a}; dazed and smoking, {a} is carried out by the wardens.

event-arena-beast.success: The masters release a manticore into the arena. {a} fights it off and it slinks away, sulking.
event-arena-beast.failure: A manticore released by the masters catches {a}, who escapes with a few scratches and a deep dislike of manticores.
event-arena-beast.defeated: A manticore corners {a}; the wardens drive it back with torches and carry {a} out of the arena.

event-arena-walls.success: With a grinding of stone, the arena walls move closer; {a} scrambles over the rubble in time.
event-arena-walls.failure: The arena walls move closer and {a} is caught by falling stones while running.
event-arena-walls.defeated: The moving walls trap {a} in a dead end; the arena wardens carry {a} away through the gate.

event-fight-clearing.win: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. {a} lands the better blows and {b} retreats into the trees.
event-fight-clearing.lose: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. {b} is quicker, and {a} has to flee, wounded.
event-fight-clearing.draw: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. Neither gives an inch; they part, panting, promising to finish it later.
event-fight-clearing.defeat: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. {a} wins the duel; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-clearing.defeated: {a} and {b} meet in a clearing and draw their weapons. {b} wins the duel; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-bridge.win: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. {a} forces {b} back to the far side.
event-fight-bridge.lose: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. {b} forces {a} back the way {{a:he|she|they}} came.
event-fight-bridge.draw: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. The bridge sways so much that they both decide to go round instead.
event-fight-bridge.defeat: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. {b} loses the fight and the footing, and splashes into the river below; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-bridge.defeated: {a} and {b} meet in the middle of a rope bridge. Only one of them will cross. {a} loses the fight and the footing, and splashes into the river below; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-night.win: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. {a} strikes true, and {b} vanishes into the night, hurt.
event-fight-night.lose: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. {b} strikes true, and {a} vanishes into the night, hurt.
event-fight-night.draw: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. They fight blind for a while, then lose each other in the darkness.
event-fight-night.defeat: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. When the moon comes out, {b} is down; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-night.defeated: In the dark, {a} stumbles right into {b}. Steel rings out. When the moon comes out, {a} is down; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-brawl.win: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. {a} keeps the bread and most of {{a:his|her|their}} teeth.
event-fight-brawl.lose: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. {b} keeps the bread; {a} keeps a black eye.
event-fight-brawl.draw: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. The bread is trampled in the fight. Nobody wins.
event-fight-brawl.defeat: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. {a} wins the brawl and the bread; the arena wardens carry {b} away, still hungry.
event-fight-brawl.defeated: {a} and {b} both reach for the same loaf of bread. It turns into a brawl. {b} wins the brawl and the bread; the arena wardens carry {a} away, still hungry.

event-fight-arrows.win: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. The shot finds its mark; {b} dives behind the rocks, wounded.
event-fight-arrows.lose: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. {b} shoots back faster, and {a} has to take cover, wounded.
event-fight-arrows.draw: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. They trade shots until both run out of patience.
event-fight-arrows.defeat: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. The arrow strikes home; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-arrows.defeated: {a} spots {b} across a ravine and nocks an arrow. {b} shoots first and better; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-spells.win: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. The spell hits {b} full on, and {b} runs off with smoking clothes.
event-fight-spells.lose: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. The spell backfires and singes {a}'s eyebrows; {b} takes the chance to strike.
event-fight-spells.draw: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. Sparks fly, the grass catches fire, and both have to run.
event-fight-spells.defeat: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. A blinding flash, and {b} is down; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-spells.defeated: {a} calls up a crackling spell as {b} comes over the hill. {b} breaks the spell and answers in kind; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-ruins.win: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. {a} drives {b} out of the ruins.
event-fight-ruins.lose: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. {b} drives {a} out of the ruins.
event-fight-ruins.draw: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. A wall collapses between them, and the fight ends there.
event-fight-ruins.defeat: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. {a} has the last word; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-ruins.defeated: {a} and {b} circle each other among the ruins of an old tower. {b} has the last word; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-mud.win: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. {a} comes out on top, muddy but proud.
event-fight-mud.lose: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. {b} comes out on top; {a} crawls away, muddy and humbled.
event-fight-mud.draw: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. Nobody can tell who is who under the mud. They give up.
event-fight-mud.defeat: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. {a} pins {b} in the mud; the arena wardens carry {b} away, dripping.
event-fight-mud.defeated: {a} charges {b} with a war cry, slips in the mud, and the fight begins on all fours. {b} pins {a} in the mud; the arena wardens carry {a} away, dripping.

event-ambush-bushes.success: {a} waits in the bushes and leaps out on {b}, who never saw it coming.
event-ambush-bushes.defeat: {a} ambushes {b} from the bushes; it is over in a moment, and the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-ambush-bushes.failure: {a} tries to ambush {b}, but sneezes at the wrong moment.
event-ambush-bushes.defeated: {a} tries to ambush {b}, who was expecting it; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-ambush-night.success: {a} creeps up on {b}'s camp in the dark and strikes before vanishing again.
event-ambush-night.defeat: {a} creeps up on {b} while {b} sleeps; at dawn, the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-ambush-night.failure: {a} creeps up on {b} in the dark and steps on a very loud twig.
event-ambush-night.defeated: {a} creeps up on {b}, who was only pretending to sleep; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-social-intimidate.success: {a} stares {b} down with a growl until {b} decides to be somewhere else.
event-social-intimidate.took: {a} glares at {b} so fiercely that {b} drops {item} and runs.
event-social-intimidate.failure: {a} tries to frighten {b}, who laughs and throws a stone at {{a:his|her|their}} head.

event-social-spare.success: Cornered by {b}, {a} talks so well about honour and the long road ahead that {b} lets {{a:him|her|them}} go.
event-social-spare.failure: Cornered by {b}, {a} tries to talk the way out. {b} is not in a talking mood.

event-social-trap.success: {a} pretends to have found treasure by a cliff. {b} goes to look and tumbles down the slope.
event-social-trap.defeat: {a} lures {b} onto a crumbling ledge with a tall tale; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-social-trap.failure: {a} tells {b} a story about hidden treasure. {b} has heard that one before.

event-social-bluff.success: {a} convinces {b} that a whole army is hiding behind the hill. {b} runs.
event-social-bluff.took: {a} convinces {b} that {item} is cursed. {b} drops it and {a} picks it up, unbothered.
event-social-bluff.failure: {a} claims to have an army behind the hill. {b} looks. There is no army.

event-social-riddle.success: {a} challenges {b} to a riddle contest and wins it with a question about wind.
event-social-riddle.took: {a} wins a riddle contest against {b}, and the prize: {item}.
event-social-riddle.failure: {a} challenges {b} to a riddle contest and loses to a question about cheese.

event-social-taunt.success: {a} shouts insults at {b} from a hilltop, so creative that {b} leaves to think about them.
event-social-taunt.failure: {a} shouts insults at {b}, who answers with better ones. {a} is wounded in {{a:his|her|their}} pride.

event-steal-camp.success: While {b} sleeps, {a} sneaks into the camp and leaves with {item}.
event-steal-camp.failure: {a} tries to steal from {b}'s camp and gets a boot thrown at {{a:his|her|their}} head.

event-steal-pickpocket.success: {a} bumps into {b}, apologises warmly, and walks away with {item}.
event-steal-pickpocket.failure: {a} bumps into {b} to pick a pocket; {b} checks every pocket and glares.

event-finish.win: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. {b} is hit again but limps away.
event-finish.lose: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. {b} finds the strength to fight back and drives {a} off.
event-finish.draw: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. {b} slips away before {a} can strike again.
event-finish.defeat: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. {a} finishes what was started; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-finish.defeated: {a} follows the trail of a wounded {b}, without mercy. Cornered, {b} fights back like a lion; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-spare.only: {a} finds {b} wounded and defenceless, and walks away. "Not like this."

event-finale-duel.defeat: The arena falls silent for the last duel. {a} and {b} fight until one of them cannot rise; it is {b}, and the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-finale-duel.defeated: The arena falls silent for the last duel. {a} and {b} fight until one of them cannot rise; it is {a}, and the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-finale-honour.defeat: {a} and {b} salute each other before a duel of honour. When {b} falls to one knee, {a} offers a hand; {b} takes it, smiles, and walks out of the arena.
event-finale-honour.defeated: {a} and {b} salute each other before a duel of honour. When {a} falls to one knee, {b} offers a hand; {a} takes it, smiles, and walks out of the arena.

event-team-heal.success: {a} tends to {b}'s wounds by the fire. By morning, {b} is back on {{b:his|her|their}} feet.
event-team-heal.failure: {a} tries to tend to {b}'s wounds, but there is little to be done without proper herbs.

event-team-heal-song.success: {a} hums an old healing song over {b}; the pain fades with each verse.
event-team-heal-song.failure: {a} sings a healing song for {b}. It does not heal, but it is a lovely song.

event-share-food.only: {a} shares {{a:his|her|their}} last rations with {b}. Neither will admit how hungry they are.

event-banter-plan.only: {a} and {b} spend the evening drawing plans in the dirt. The plans get more ambitious with every hour.

event-banter-joke.only: {a} tells {b} a joke so bad that {b} laughs for ten minutes. Somewhere, a rival hears and wonders.

event-banter-watch.only: {a} keeps watch so that {b} can sleep. Then they swap. Nobody sneaks up on them tonight.

event-trade.only: {a} gives {item} to {b}: "You will need it more than I do."

event-alliance-offer.success: {a} lowers {{a:his|her|their}} weapon and offers {b} an alliance. After a long silence, {b} shakes on it.
event-alliance-offer.failure: {a} offers {b} an alliance. {b} answers by backing away slowly, never turning around.

event-alliance-fire.success: Freezing, {b} approaches the fire of {a}, who makes room. By morning, they are allies.
event-alliance-fire.failure: {b} approaches the fire of {a}, who throws a pinecone in warning. The message is clear.

event-split-argument.only: Old grudges catch up with {a} and {b}. After a bitter argument, {a} walks away from the team for good.

event-split-share.only: {a} catches {b} hiding food from the team. That was the last straw: {a} goes alone from now on.

event-betray-sleep.success: While {b} sleeps, {a} breaks their alliance with a treacherous blow, and is gone before dawn.
event-betray-sleep.defeat: {a} waits until {b} is asleep and ends their alliance in the cruellest way; the arena wardens carry {b} away.

event-betray-back.success: {a} smiles at {b}, then strikes. "Nothing personal. It's the arena."
event-betray-back.defeat: {a} turns on {b} without warning. "Nothing personal." The arena wardens carry {b} away.

event-protect.success: {c} goes for the wounded {b}, but {a} steps in between and drives {c} back.
event-protect.failure: {a} throws {{a:himself|herself|themself}} between {b} and {c}, and takes the blows meant for {b}.
event-protect.defeat: {a} rushes to protect {b} from {c}, and wins; the arena wardens carry {c} away.
event-protect.defeated: {a} stands between {b} and {c} to the very end; the arena wardens carry {a} away, but {b} is safe.

event-protect-leader.success: "Behind me!" {a} shields {b} and faces {c}, who thinks better of it.
event-protect-leader.failure: "Behind me!" {a} shields {b} from {c} and pays for it with a few wounds.
event-protect-leader.defeat: "Behind me!" {a} leads the defence of {b} against {c} and wins; the arena wardens carry {c} away.
event-protect-leader.defeated: "Behind me!" {a} holds {c} off long enough for {b} to escape; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-sacrifice.only: When {c} closes in on the wounded {b}, {a} takes the blow instead and falls. The arena wardens carry {a} out, while {b} gets away.

event-team-camp.only: {a} and {b} build a hidden camp under the roots of a fallen tree, and take turns sleeping.

event-team-scout.only: {a} scouts ahead while {b} watches their backs. They move through the arena like a single shadow.

event-team-oath.only: By the fire, {a} and {b} renew an old promise: whatever happens, they leave this arena together.

event-team-heal-herbs.success: {a} gathers silverleaf and makes a poultice for {b}. It stings, it smells, and it works.
event-team-heal-herbs.failure: {a} gathers herbs for {b}, but picks the wrong ones. At least they smell nice.

event-share-water.only: {a} finds a spring and fills both flasks, the one for {b} first.

event-alliance-enemy.success: {a} and {b} have been chased by the same rival all day. By evening, they agree to face the threat together.
event-alliance-enemy.failure: {a} suggests to {b} that they team up against a common rival. {b} suspects a trap, and walks away.

event-betray-draught.success: {a} offers {b} a cup of herbal tea laced with a sleeping draught, then slips away with a quiet "sorry".
event-betray-draught.defeat: {a} slips a sleeping draught into the cup of {b}; the arena wardens carry {b} away, snoring.

event-split-chaotic.only: {a} announces to {b} that teamwork is overrated and wanders off whistling.

event-prank.success: {a} fills the boots of {b} with pinecones during the night. {b} spends the morning limping and swearing.
event-prank.failure: {a} tries to fill the boots of {b} with pinecones and is caught red-handed.

event-fight-stream.win: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. {a} reacts first and chases {b} downstream.
event-fight-stream.lose: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. {b} reacts first and chases {a} downstream.
event-fight-stream.draw: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. They splash at each other for a while, then both retreat, soaked.
event-fight-stream.defeat: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. The fight is short and splashy; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-stream.defeated: {a} and {b} both kneel to drink at the same stream, look up, and freeze. The fight is short and splashy; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-cave.win: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. {a} wins the cave; {b} spends the night outside, nursing a bruise.
event-fight-cave.lose: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. {b} keeps the cave; {a} spends the night outside, nursing a bruise.
event-fight-cave.draw: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. After a long scuffle in the dark, they grudgingly sleep at opposite ends.
event-fight-cave.defeat: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. The cave echoes with the fight; at dawn, the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-cave.defeated: {a} ducks into a cave to sleep, and finds {b} already there. The cave echoes with the fight; at dawn, the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-honour.win: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." {a} has the upper hand, and lets {b} withdraw with dignity.
event-fight-honour.lose: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." {b} has the upper hand, and {a} withdraws with a nod of respect.
event-fight-honour.draw: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." The duel is perfectly even. They part with a salute.
event-fight-honour.defeat: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." {a} wins the duel of honour; {b} yields, and the arena wardens carry {b} out with respect.
event-fight-honour.defeated: {a} calls out to {b}: "Face me openly, and let the best one win." {b} wins the duel of honour; {a} yields, and the arena wardens carry {a} out with respect.

event-fight-spells-night.win: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. Dazzled, {b} stumbles away into the night.
event-fight-spells-night.lose: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. {b} shields {{b:his|her|their}} eyes and charges; {a} has to flee, scorched by the backlash.
event-fight-spells-night.draw: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. The spell lights up the whole arena, and both decide to hide before anyone else comes.
event-fight-spells-night.defeat: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. A second spell finishes the duel; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-spells-night.defeated: In the dark, {a} lights up the clearing with a spell, right in the face of {b}. {b} strikes before the second spell; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-fight-sling.win: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. The shot hits home, and {b} runs zigzagging for the trees.
event-fight-sling.lose: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. {b} dodges and shoots back; {a} has to leave the rock in a hurry.
event-fight-sling.draw: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. Every shot misses. Both pretend they meant to.
event-fight-sling.defeat: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. The shot is perfect; the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-fight-sling.defeated: From the top of a rock, {a} takes aim at {b}, who is crossing a field below. {b} shoots back, and better; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-ambush-tree.success: {a} drops from a tree onto {b}, strikes, and is gone before {b} understands what happened.
event-ambush-tree.defeat: {a} drops from a tree onto {b}; it is over at once, and the arena wardens carry {b} away.
event-ambush-tree.failure: {a} drops from a tree onto {b}, misses, and lands in a bush. {b} laughs on the way out.
event-ambush-tree.defeated: {a} drops from a tree, straight onto the raised weapon of {b}; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-find-statue.success: {a} reads the old inscription on a statue, presses the right stone, and a hidden niche opens: {item}.
event-find-statue.failure: {a} presses every stone of an old statue. One of them was a wasp nest.

event-hazard-wolves.success: A pack of wolves circles the camp of {a}, who waves a burning branch until they leave.
event-hazard-wolves.failure: Wolves attack {a} in the night; it takes a long fight to drive them off.
event-hazard-wolves.defeated: A pack of wolves corners {a}; the wardens drive them off with horns and torches, and carry {a} out of the arena.

event-hazard-thorns.success: {a} finds a way through a field of thornbushes without a single scratch.
event-hazard-thorns.failure: {a} tries to cut through a field of thornbushes and comes out looking like a pincushion.
event-hazard-thorns.defeated: {a} gets hopelessly tangled in a field of enchanted thorns; the arena wardens carry {a} away.

event-quiet-letter.only: By the light of a small fire, {a} writes a letter home, in case. Then tears it up, out of stubbornness.

event-quiet-crowd.only: {a} climbs onto a rock and bows to the invisible crowd. Somewhere, the arena masters are applauding.

event-rest-spring.only: {a} finds a hot spring hidden between the rocks, and soaks until every ache is gone.
